Treatments start at IDR 69.000 per person, and spa packages at IDR 299.000 per person.

props.title: What Is a Day Spa?
props.text: A day spa is a spa you visit for a few hours, with no overnight stay, to have one or several treatments without rushing between appointments. At Spa Bali Moon, a visit can include a Balinese massage, facial, body scrub, cream bath, reflexology or a manicure and pedicure.
props.feature1Text: Choose from massage, skin care, body treatments, hair care, and beauty services during one visit.
props.feature2Text: Build a shorter visit around one or two treatments or stay longer with a selection of services that suit your day.

props.title: Ways to Spend Your Day at the Spa
props.text: After a long flight you might start with a gentle massage; before a special occasion, you might focus on skin and beauty care.
featuresLeft: Balinese massage for traditional full-body care
Aromatherapy massage for gentle relaxation with essential oils
Sports and deep tissue massage for tired or tight muscles
Body scrub to refresh and smooth the skin
featuresRight: Facials to cleanse and care for the complexion
Cream bath for the hair, scalp, and a soothing head massage
Foot reflexology for focused pressure-point care
Manicure and pedicure for polished hands and feet

props.title: Why a Longer Visit Is Worth It
props.text: Giving yourself more than an hour allows different types of care to work together. A massage can help your body release physical tension, while a facial or body scrub brings attention to the skin.
featuresLeft: More time to relax during your holiday
Massage, body care, facials, and beauty treatments
featuresRight: Suitable for solo guests, couples, and groups

props.title: Skilled Therapists in a Comfortable Seminyak Space
props.text: Our therapists adjust every treatment to how your body feels on the day. Spa Bali Moon has been in Seminyak since 2009, with calm private rooms, including rooms for couples, and the same therapists also come to villas and hotels.

items.question: What does a day spa in Seminyak usually include?
items.answer: A day spa visit usually includes one or more services such as massage, facial care, body scrubs, cream bath, reflexology, manicure or pedicure. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, you choose the treatments and how long to stay, in a private room.

items.question: How many hours should I spend at a day spa?
items.answer: Plan on 1 to 1.5 hours for a single treatment at Spa Bali Moon, or a few hours if you combine several. Spa packages combine two or three treatments in one visit.

items.question: Can I choose my own treatments for a day spa visit?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon you can select individual treatments, from IDR 69.000 per person, or choose a spa package from IDR 299.000 per person. If you are unsure which treatments work well together, message our team on WhatsApp and we can help plan a visit around your schedule and preferences.

items.question: Which spa treatment is best after a flight?
items.answer: A relaxing full-body massage, such as a Balinese massage, is often a good place to begin after a flight. Depending on how you feel, you can follow it with a facial, body scrub, cream bath or foot treatment for a longer visit at Spa Bali Moon.

items.question: Can I book a day spa at my hotel or villa?
items.answer: Yes, for selected treatments. Spa Bali Moon arranges home service at hotels and villas in Seminyak and nearby areas, and our therapists bring fresh linen, oils and everything your treatments need. Prices match our spa menu, plus IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Send your treatments, location, date and time on WhatsApp.

items.question: Do I need to book a day spa in advance?
items.answer: Booking in advance is recommended, especially at weekends, on holidays and during busy periods in Seminyak, as it helps Spa Bali Moon arrange your preferred treatments and appointment time. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: How do I book home service for a day spa?
items.answer: Send Spa Bali Moon a message on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 with your preferred treatments, location, date and time. Our team will confirm availability and provide the details needed for your appointment. Home service is available for selected treatments in Seminyak and nearby areas, for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How much does a day spa package cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Spa packages at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak start at IDR 299.000 per person. The Balinese massage packages, IDR 379.000 to IDR 549.000 per person, combine a Balinese massage with a manicure and pedicure, cream bath or facial. You can also build your own package on WhatsApp. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Where is Spa Bali Moon and when is it open?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon is at Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, Bali, and is open daily from 9am to 11pm. A day spa in Seminyak since 2009, it has private rooms, including rooms for couples, and offers home service at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my day spa visit?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your day spa visit on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

props.title: Leave Room in Your Bali Holiday for Yourself
props.text: Seminyak fills a day quickly. A few hours at Spa Bali Moon is a reason to slow down: choose a massage, add body or beauty care, and leave feeling rested.
